parent.ddl: CREATE TABLE profile_rotation_events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, old_revisioned_machine_profile_hash TEXT, new_revisioned_machine_profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL, old_profile_activation_epoch INTEGER, new_profile_activation_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (new_profile_activation_epoch > 0), changed_fields_json TEXT NOT NULL, previous_snapshot_json TEXT, current_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, module_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE (new_revisioned_machine_profile_hash, new_profile_activation_epoch))
parent.identity: one event for each committed activation epoch
parent.first_store: no parent event; epoch 1 snapshot is persisted without a rotation event

children.ddl: CREATE TABLE profile_rotation_certification_outcomes (event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profile_rotation_events(event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, model_id TEXT NOT NULL, decode_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, outcome_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome_state IN ('not_required','required','in_progress','passed','failed')), certified_at_ms INTEGER, failure_reason TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (event_id, model_id, decode_fingerprint))

transaction: read persisted hash and positive epoch
insert affected approval children with pending and terminal outcomes
atomic_write.cas: UPDATE profile_state SET snapshot_json=?, revisioned_machine_profile_hash=?, profile_activation_epoch=? WHERE revisioned_machine_profile_hash=? AND profile_activation_epoch=?
atomic_write.loser: re-read committed snapshot and epoch; emit no event and do not increment
atomic_write.duplicate_event: UNIQUE(new_revisioned_machine_profile_hash,new_profile_activation_epoch) causes adoption, never a second event

changed_field_rules.normal: top-level persisted MachineProfile field names sorted in ASCII order and joined with commas
changed_field_rules.unknown_previous_snapshot: permitted only when old hash and epoch are structurally valid but detailed old fields are unavailable
changed_field_rules.malformed_state: corruption and fail closed; never use unknown_previous_snapshot

recovery.startup: re-read the last committed parent and adopt it without emitting a duplicate
recovery.child_missing: health reports required or failed according to durable parent state; recovery may insert missing children only in a fenced transaction
recovery.orphan_child: reject as corruption; foreign event_id cannot satisfy admission
recovery.partial_commit: SQLite rollback leaves snapshot, epoch, parent, and children at the prior committed state
recovery.audit_query: all three observed epochs in A/epoch-1 -> B/epoch-2 -> A/epoch-3 remain queryable
